The study compares three calculations on Engine commit `05e94210`.
The tracking model uses the retained coefficients. The 100 kPa control
changes the reaction reference with those coefficients held fixed. The
refit varies the designated coordinates with the same residual definitions
and external observation pressures. DEA and AMP also take the selected MEA
donor before refitting.

Each design uses an incumbent and two displaced starts from a 64-point
Latin hypercube with seed 427. The distances are root mean square differences
on the unit coordinate box. A relative objective tie favors the incumbent.
The selected fit is a local result. The calibration residuals, the
comparison against measurements, and the model's finite phase searches have
different meanings. Conditional standard errors describe the declared fit
and active bounds. The study awaits independent evidence review and
investigator promotion for manuscript use.

[Quantity index](manuscript-handoff.json) records contributor hashes, pressure
and population basis, and open quantities.

## MDEA–water slope bound (#427)

Stage 0 used the study wheel with the reaction reference fixed at 100 kPa.
The lower slope bound is 0.0005507469177 K⁻¹. The upper slope bound is 0.01 K⁻¹.

A replays all 281 predictions at cost 15.609314353577124, with maximum relative prediction and conditional standard-error differences of 0 and 0. Only the upper bound on $a_0$ is active.

At 288.71 K and 1.466 MPa, the binary liquid hull brackets gap onset between -0.1328280449 and -0.1328273773. At the $(U,s)$ corner, $k=-0.141073258$ is 0.00824521 below the no-gap end of the bracket.

The four corners had 0 gaps in 136 temperature–corner checks on the 5,490-point composition grid. The LHS-53 control had a gap with MDEA mole-fraction contacts 0.0088 and 0.3078. These are finite-grid model checks.

2 of 64 draws had every row available. The census recorded 17363 available and 621 unavailable rows (Cp 9, Kuranov 436, Merkley 176). All MDEA–water bubble rows were available. The census records Engine responses at the declared vectors.

The approved two-wheel exception applies to the #427 candidate checks, fits and descent probes. Endpoint values are reported on the study wheel. The fit comparison awaits the second wheel. [Accepted plan](https://github.com/tannerpolley/Amine-Thermodynamics/issues/427#issuecomment-7178782607).

[Declaration](results/MDEA_slope_bound/declaration.json.gz) · [A replay](results/MDEA_slope_bound/replay-A.json.gz) · [Onsets](results/MDEA_slope_bound/onset-S.json) · [Hulls](results/MDEA_slope_bound/hull-S.json) · [Row census](results/MDEA_slope_bound/census-S.json.gz) · [Checks and message counts](results/MDEA_slope_bound/checks.json.gz).

Run `taskset -c 0-7 uv run --locked python analyses/fixed_reaction_reference/diagnosis-starts/stage0.py` from the repository root to repeat Stage 0. Add `--check` to recompute the checks from the retained records.

For the MEA census-grid, Cai and Kundu parents, adjacent densities bracket the target pressure and the closest scan points still miss the ordinary pressure limit. Fix 1a admits the density with the smallest absolute pressure error in each of these scans. All three reruns completed without descent at the selected densities. For Hartono, the original search window contains a qualifying density. None of the declared reactions are on that liquid support. Reclosure gave a relative pressure residual of −1.60e−11 and both trial protocols completed without descent.

The 321 measured MEA searches comprise 307 liquid and 14 liquid–vapor parents. The qualified DEA pairs cover five Weiland feeds and the Lawson and Garst composition at 7.97232 kPa, which is 1.05 times the model bubble pressure. The searches use the declared models.

Both historical MDEA targets at 383.15 K, 121.309 MPa and loading 1.368 completed the declared finite search with zero descents. The continued vapor amount reached zero along each parameter and reference-pressure path. The AMP bubble solves are model predictions on the same feeds as their pressure controls. The three searches tied to [Engine #265](https://github.com/tannerpolley/epcsaft/issues/265) remain open.
The support census matched every prior support set, so it triggered no screen reruns.

The first gradient uses the bound-normalized coordinate widths and zeros outward components within $10^{-6}$ optimizer units of a bound. The Engine gradient uses optimizer coordinates and the displacement $u-\operatorname{clip}(u-J^\mathsf{T}r,l,h)$. The pinned Engine computes it in `engine/native/regression/fit.cpp` at commit `05e94210`. The inherited gradient tolerance is $10^{-8}$ in these optimizer coordinates. Ceres can also stop on its function or parameter tolerance. A replayed objective and a Ceres convergence report are shown separately from the gradient check.

## MDEA fit limits

The tightened Ceres continuation from A used 40 iterations and returned objective 15.6093143505 with optimizer projected gradient 0.00827173. Its rejected trials concentrated on the Merkley heat observation at zero-based row 124. The saturation search could not admit the vapor root at 1.5 mol carbon dioxide per mol analytical amine.

The shortest tested projected-gradient step gave objective 15.6093133277 and relative reduction 6.57205e-08. The decrease exceeds the inherited $10^{-10}$ relative function tolerance. The two larger Gauss–Newton steps increased the objective and the smaller steps returned unexamined saturation gaps.

At start B, all 30 loading nodes returned bubble pressures from 24.4 to 186.6 kPa for each of three pressure guesses. All admitted nodes at C exceeded 1,962 kPa. The target was 1,121 kPa in both cases. These finite samples leave feasibility undecided. Among the 64 LHS draws, 61 were screened as replacements, two were the original failures, and one fell below the separation limit after admitting the replacement. With A, this yields two admitted starts in the declared design.

The MDEA tables retain the phase and property comparisons at the provisional A endpoint.

Restarting Ceres on the admitted descent step returned objective 15.6093124974 and optimizer projected gradient 0.00730911. Parameter tolerance reached. Relative step_norm: 3.546698e-11 <= 1.000000e-10.

The Ceres function exits for MEA, DEA and both AMP fits are consistent with the small changes in the independent descent replays. They missed the separate strict gradient threshold. A second displaced AMP fixed-slope start returned the high-objective basin reached by C within the relative objective tie tolerance. The basin is reproducible at the fit tolerance, with several active bounds and an unresolved strict gradient check.


## Numerical reproduction on the current water caloric basis

R1 originally stopped at zero-based row 129. The weighted residual was 1.524754706513316 against 1.526051434252232 at tolerance $10^{-8}$. Commit `32e572051` replaced the water ideal-gas caloric correlation. With the archived water record restored on the study wheel, the predicted heat capacity for unloaded 30 wt% MDEA was 94.32571302040229 J/(mol feed K), compared with 94.32571302040198 in the archive. The current-basis expectations use the archived residuals plus the measured water-record correction for the 33 heat-capacity rows.

R1 reproduced the B1 objective (374.446741289) with maximum weighted residual error 5.85e-11. R3 reproduced the Ermatchkov AARD (19.14601240%) on 88 rows at or below 49 wt% MDEA. R5 reproduced the A3 objective (403.729440371) with maximum weighted residual error 3.54e-11 and matching coordinates.

## Reference derivatives

Each pressure or temperature perturbation re-solves the same conserved feed with $P_s$ held at 100 kPa. The reconstructed extensive potential is $G^*=G_{\rm EOS}+RT\sum_i n_i b_i$. The pressure stencil tests $\partial G^*/\partial P=\sum_\alpha n_\alpha/\rho_\alpha$. The temperature stencil tests $-T^2\partial(G^*/T)/\partial T$ against Eq. 12 and the Engine enthalpy.
The error envelope combines the Engine arithmetic estimate for the potential and the spread across admitted steps. The retained MDEA high-pressure daughters are separate conserved inventories for this check.

## Stage timing

Measured entries record timed calculations. The lanes overlapped.

| Stage | Allowance (s) | Stop (s) | Throughput projection (s) | Measured (s) | Disposition |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Wheel, salt and start manifests | 300 | 450 | — | 77.113211 | replayed |
| MEA fits and donor | 1800 | 2700 | 278.81369 | 136.65667 | selected with stationarity missed |
| DEA receiver | 1080 | 1620 | 274.52951 | 639.21331 | replayed |
| MDEA receiver | 7320 | 10980 | 4802.0397 | 2597.8696 | replayed |
| AMP receiver, both designs | 4500 | 6750 | 1963.7199 | 1042.1909 | replayed |
| MEA screens and displayed comparisons | 1500 | 2250 | 1253.2789 | 1798.36 | retained with unresolved searches |
| C1–C7 numerical replays | 600 | 900 | 600 | 1209.7555 | retained with open quantities and stop overrun |

**Wheel, salt and start manifests.** The stage timers include bound manifest and tracking-control evaluation by design. The initial failed probe is recorded separately from retained successful controls.

**MEA fits and donor.** The displaced B fit and independent replay preceded the decision to expand. The loose incumbent-start sensitivity is included in measured fit time.

**DEA receiver.** The first screen let the saved trial registry grow between batches. Those calculations are retained. The second screen used the unchanged declared trial bank.

**MDEA receiver.** B refused on its initial evaluation and on independent replay. A reached the iteration limit twice and converged within the original lane budget on its third stage. The measured subtotal combines the fit, replay and diagnostics of all attempts with the final campaign service, which reduced observations, phase controls and release screens. The expansion forecast in MDEA/projection.json used archived round-7 fit timings after displaced start B refused. This departed from the binding requirement to measure B through fit and independent replay before expansion.

**AMP receiver, both designs.** The measured subtotal combines the displaced B pilots, screen pilots and the four-worker expansion. The expansion forecast in AMP/projection.json used archived round-7 fit timings after displaced start B refused. This departed from the binding requirement to measure B through fit and independent replay before expansion.

**MEA screens and displayed comparisons.** The service wall includes the pilot and release screens. The seven-row refinement pilot admitted two rows. Its release gate stopped the remaining refinement. The original 321 measured-state results and the one unavailable offset search remain in the denominator.

**C1–C7 numerical replays.** The measured subtotal covers timed C1 evaluations, the MDEA curve runs and the completed AMP conditional profile. The MDEA curve subtotal includes the 480.273 s stop on the oversized historical declaration and the completed replays on 483 source keys. The AMP profile completed in 466.0 s and supplied both crossings. The timed subtotal exceeded the 900 s stop by 309.8 s. Other C2–C7 reductions use retained readbacks and have no separate wall times here. The selected fixed-slope fit at −150 K and its controls completed in the receiver lane.

## Coverage

The quantity index contains 1783 replayed comparisons and 12 quantities with independent contributors. It records 105 open keys and 78 undecided results.

Tables preserve exact comparisons at discrete feeds, fitted endpoints and pressure controls. A phase outcome applies to its finite trials and recorded pressure and feed.

## Reproduction

Run from the repository root with the installed study wheel verified against `c9fbf898b14d004f915f01ed77675867908dd30d77dc28544b2860e9195c80bb`. Use `refit.py prepare`, `refit.py attempt` and `refit.py select` for the named design. Use `phase_replays.py pilot` on the bound A declaration after timing displaced B through its independent replay. For an initial refusal use `refit.py initial DESIGN B` to retain the independent replay refusal. The receiver expansion is `campaign.py DEA`, `campaign.py MDEA` or `campaign.py AMP`. Use `refit.py replace DESIGN` for the seeded replacement screen and then `refit.py attempt DESIGN LHS-NN` for an admitted draw. Run `stationarity.py DESIGN START` for the descent probe. Use `stationarity.py root` or `stationarity.py amp-roots` for the pressure-guess diagnostics. The MDEA diagnostic commands are `stationarity.py mdea-continue`, `stationarity.py mdea-descent` and `stationarity.py mdea-restart`. Use `property_replays.py AMP-profile` for the conditional slope profile. The selected MEA screen uses `mea_replays.py`. The derivative checks use `reference_derivatives.py fixed-at-old` and `reference_derivatives.py selected`.

Recompute the handoff with `uv run --no-sync python analyses/fixed_reaction_reference/handoff.py --check`.
